lines.speaker: Robot
lines.text: Arre bhai Teddy! Dekh, main to calculator bhi hoon. Tu kya kar sakta hai?
lines.action: chest pe haath rakh kar khara ho jata hai

lines.speaker: Teddy
lines.text: Haan haan, lekin jab bachcha rota hai toh woh mujhe gale lagata hai, teri taraf nahi dekhta.

lines.speaker: Robot
lines.text: Oh really? Lekin main usay din ke teen waqt homework mein help karta hoon. Tu toh bas sonay ke kaam aata hai!

lines.speaker: Teddy
lines.text: Achha? Toh bata, kal raat jab bijli gayi thi, toh kis ne bachche ka khauf door kiya? Mera naam lo!
lines.action: apne pairon par khara ho kar jhoomta hai

lines.speaker: Robot
lines.text: Hmm... woh toh main bhi kar sakta hoon! Emergency light mode hai mere paas.
lines.action: apna button daba kar light jhalakata hai

lines.speaker: Teddy
lines.text: Haha, lekin tere paas garmi aur narmi nahi hai. Bachcha mujhe chhod kar nahi sota.
lines.action: apne soft fur ko dikhata hai

lines.speaker: Robot
lines.text: Theek hai, theek hai. Dono ki apni value hai. Lekin agar battery low ho jaye toh?

lines.speaker: Teddy
lines.text: Toh main toh hamesha ready hoon. No charging required, buddy!
